title: mcp: list_objects / describe_object cannot see any package-installed object (a marketplace app's whole schema) — the HTTP bridge reads the metadata service, not the SchemaRegistry REST serves
body:
Filing gate **① a reproduced defect**. `reach:` measured live on ObjectOS Cloud production, `https://huayan.objectos.ai`, framework pin `9d13b5fc83`, 2026-10-21. The MCP client used an API key over Streamable HTTP. The maintainer asked for this card in a cloud session: 「查清 MCP 看不到 HotCRM 对象的根因…你直接写issue就可以」.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage → the `runtime` / `mcp` lane (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`).

## What fails

The MCP discovery tools cannot see any object an installed **package** contributes. That includes a whole marketplace app. `huayan` has HotCRM 5.1.2 installed (`app.objectstack.hotcrm`, 18 `crm_*` objects) and one environment-authored app (`app.p2p1`, 3 objects). Every call below used the same API key:

| Call | Answer |
| :-- | :-- |
| REST `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (browser session) | 29 non-`sys_` objects: 18 `crm_*` + 8 `ai_*` (`_provenance: "package"`) + 3 `p2p1_*` (no `_provenance`) |
| REST `GET /api/v1/data/crm_opportunity` (key) | 200, `total: 23` |
| MCP `list_objects` | **3 objects**, only the `p2p1_*` ones, as `totalCount: 3` with no `partial` flag |
| MCP `describe_object` `crm_opportunity` / `crm_product` / `crm_campaign` / `ai_conversations` | `Object "<name>" not found` ×4 |
| MCP `describe_object` `p2p1_expense_item` | served |
| MCP `query_records` `crm_opportunity` | **served**, records returned |

So the data path works and only discovery is blind. An agent follows the tool contract: list, then describe, then query. It concludes HotCRM is not installed, and it never reaches a query that would have worked. The listing claims a complete `totalCount: 3`, so nothing tells the agent the answer is short.

It is not the objects' validity. `crm_opportunity` carries `_diagnostics.valid: false` (a `picklist` + `options` clash), but `crm_product` and `crm_campaign` are valid and are missing all the same. Every `ai_*` object, all valid, is missing too. The split runs exactly along `_provenance: "package"`.

## Cause

`buildMcpBridge` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) serves `list_objects` and `describe_object` from the per-env **metadata service**:

```ts
const objs = (await meta?.listObjects?.()) ?? [];   // listObjectSummaries
const def  = await meta?.getObject?.(name);         // describeObject
```

`MetadataManager.listObjects()` is `list('object')`, and `readListUncached` reads only the manager's own `registry` plus its loaders (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`). Objects an installed package or a plugin registers live in the ObjectQL `SchemaRegistry`. REST's `getMetaItems` reads that registry (`this.engine.registry.listItems(...)` in `readFlattenedMetaItems`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) and merges the overlay on top. MCP never reads it. Environment-authored objects (`p2p1_*`) reach the manager through its `sys_metadata` loader, which is why they alone show up.

The repo has already fixed the same shape once for skills. Commit `e783e163d` moved the MCP skill read off `metadataService.list('skill')` onto the merged `getMetaItems` read, with `McpMergedMetadataRead = Pick<MetadataProtocol, 'getMetaItems'>` declared in this same file. Its comment reads "two surfaces, one skill name, two answers". Objects were left on the lower read.

`origin/main` has not changed `domains/mcp.ts` or `metadata-manager.ts` since `9d13b5fc83`.

## Possible second consequence (code reading, not walked)

#23689 records that the MCP exposure gate reads `metadataService.getObject(object).enable.apiEnabled` and treats an absent copy as "no declaration", i.e. **allowed**. A package object has no metadata-service copy here. So a package object declared `apiEnabled: false` may be served by `query_records` and the write verbs. The served `query_records` on `crm_opportunity` above is consistent with that path, though that object is not declared off. The fix should close both, and its acceptance should walk an `apiEnabled: false` package object.

## Not a duplicate

`Dedupe:` REST `search/issues`, closed included —
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack list_objects package` → 49
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack describe_object "not found" mcp` → 15
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack mcp listObjects metadata service registry` → 17
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack buildMcpBridge` → 36

The nearest are **#23661 / #23687** and **#23689 / #23716** (closed). They give a **runtime-authored** object (created after boot) a metadata-service copy, on the non-env and the `environmentId` kernel respectively. This card is the other producer: objects that arrive by **package install or plugin registration** into the `SchemaRegistry`. Those never get a copy at all, at boot or later, as the 18 + 8 objects above show on a pin that carries those fixes. #23528 (closed) is the exposure gate's refusal envelope, not discovery.

## Suggested direction (for the lane to judge)

Serve `list_objects` / `describe_object`, and the exposure gate's declaration read, from the merged `getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` view REST serves, as `e783e163d` did for skills. Do not mirror package objects into the metadata manager, because a second copy is a second thing to keep in sync. Keep the `listDiagnosed('object')` verdict for `partial`.

Acceptance:
- On a kernel with an installed package, `list_objects` includes the package's objects and `describe_object` answers them. Its count equals the non-`sys_` count `GET /api/v1/meta/object` serves to the same principal.
- A package object declared `apiEnabled: false` is refused by every MCP data verb.
- Walked on a cloud environment with a marketplace app installed (e.g. HotCRM), not only on a standalone kernel.
